ios._comment_limitsNavigationsToAppBoundDoma: Left off deliberately. Enabling it requires a WKAppBoundDomains array in Info.plist, and with none declared WKWebView treats no domain as app-bound: map tiles, a remote ONEBAR_API_BASE, region-pack downloads and the tel:/sms: handoffs in the SOS screen would all be blocked, and evaluateJavaScript is disabled so plugin callbacks stop arriving. This app legitimately loads third-party map tiles, so app-bound domains is the wrong mechanism for it.
